name: Kwalifier
description: People miss bank offers they already qualify for. Kwalifier started as a PRD assignment and became a working side project: an AI assistant that tells customers exactly which offers, benefits, and products they qualify for, based on their own account data and the bank's official offer catalogue. Grounded in RAG, it never speculates.

name: Vendor ITC Recovery Agent
description: Businesses lose tax credit when a vendor files late and nobody notices. This GST reconciliation tool matches purchase registers against GSTR-2B, flags blocked Input Tax Credit, and drafts vendor follow-up emails for human approval: deterministic matching first, AI arbitration only when genuinely ambiguous.

name: n8n User Research Automation
description: Nobody has time to read app store reviews every day. This automated workflow scrapes App Store and Play Store reviews daily, aggregates feedback, and surfaces themes, eliminating manual research bottlenecks.

name: RAG Simulator
description: Most people deciding on RAG features have never watched a query move through the pipeline. This interactive simulator shows how Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems work, built to help PMs and engineers visualize AI retrieval flows.
